name: Piston (re-run with template v4)
axis: Axis: number of horizontal pistons (1, 2, 3, 4), then exhaust stacks, a second tier, a crystal tank, a crown manifold.
identity: a rust-red block-shaped body on a cream plate with LONG GREY STEEL HORIZONTAL PISTONS poking out of its front and sides, like a chunky toy of punching rods. It must NOT look like a vertical hydraulic press.
ranks: A rust-red block body with rounded corners and ONE long grey steel piston poking out of the front-left.
Rank 1 plus a second long piston, splayed slightly apart from the first (two pistons).
Rank 2 plus a third long piston (three pistons fanning out) and thin brass rings on every piston.
Rank 3 plus a fourth piston poking out of the right side and a steam pipe on the back sticking up high above the body.
Rank 4 plus two tall brass exhaust stacks on top of the body and a round glass window in the front with a glowing orange core.
Rank 5 plus a second, smaller rust-red block stacked on top with four short grey steel pistons poking out of it (eight pistons in total).
Rank 6 plus a blue-white crystal pressure tank on the very top, clearly WIDER and TALLER than the upper block, with a gold cap ring.
Rank 7 plus a gold crown-shaped manifold around the crystal, two gold fins at the sides and a small ornate gold and white plate. The most impressive machine on the sheet, still clean.
